input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: email_password_login.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"]
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
+
+
+def sign_in_with_email_password(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    payload = {
+        "grant_type": "http://auth0.com/oauth/grant-type/password-realm",
+        "username": email,
+        "password": password,
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "realm": "Username-Password-Authentication",
+    }
+    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
+        payload["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE
+    response = requests.post(f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token", json=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: register_user.py
+import os
+import requests
+
+
+FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = os.environ["FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"]
+FIREBASE_API_KEY = os.environ["FIREBASE_API_KEY"]
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str) -> dict:
+    url = f"https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signUp?key={FIREBASE_API_KEY}"
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        json={"email": email, "password": password, "returnSecureToken": True},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
*** End Patch
